segment.source: Wrap a card to emphasize an important workspace summary without changing the card interaction model.
segment.target: Wrap a cartão para emphasize an important workspace summary sem changing o cartão interaction model.

segment.source: The segmented selector switches the color stop collection used by the beam.
segment.target: O segmented selector switches o cor stop collection usado por o beam.

segment.source: Use multiple color stops to build different beam presets, following the Ant Design customized color demo.
segment.target: Usar múltiplos cor stops para build diferente beam presets, seguinte o Ant Design customized cor demo.

segment.source: The top corners keep a larger radius while the bottom corners remain square.
segment.target: O superior corners keep a larger raio while o inferior corners remain quadrado.

segment.source: Set Outset to 0 when the decorated container clips its own corners.
segment.target: Definir Outset para 0 quando o decorated container clips its own corners.

segment.source: BorderBeam wraps a content control and renders a non-interactive beam on its border. It is decorative, stays active independently of the global motion setting by default, and can use a solid color or gradient stops.
segment.target: BorderBeam wraps a conteúdo controle e renders a non-interactive beam em its borda. Isso é decorative, stays active independently de o global motion configuração por padrão, e pode usar a solid cor ou gradient stops.

segment.source: Draw an animated highlight along a container boundary.
segment.target: Draw an animated highlight along a container boundary.
